p: Played well in his first start at left tackle, and the coach is building depth around him.
A good start by a replacement tackle supports the offense and Lamar's protection, and could help Vinson hold the job if Stanley is limited.
I thought he did well. Really in both phases.
Carson Vinson could play a bigger role on the offensive line if injuries require it, after seeing snaps in jumbo packages in Week 1.
He is a depth option on the offensive line with a growing role; his fantasy impact is limited to the offense's blocking quality.
I think he's one of our most improved players.
